entityDescription:
Boeing Research & Technology Europe, S.L. (BR&TE) is wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, and it's the first research and technology center Boeing establishes outside of the US. The opening of this European research center in Madrid is part of Boeing initiative to become a true global company. BR&TE belongs to Boeing Research and Technology division. Boeing Research and Technology is the advanced R&D unit and catalyst of innovation for Boeing enterprise. We are innovators and integrators working across the Boeing Global Enterprise to create the future of aerospace. BR&TE in the European Community The center was legally constituted in November 2001 and started its activities in March 2002. Since then, the center has become an active member of the European technology fabric, contributing to establish a permanent footprint of Boeing in Europe as key player in the R&D community. BR&TE has allowed Boeing to establish a strong presence in Europe. 

Since it opened in 2002, its mission has been to work with partners across Europe in research and technology development to foster innovation, excellence and competitiveness within the European research and development community. A lean and agile organization, BR&T–Europe maintains the infrastructure to support other Boeing business units on demand with complementary asset and skill-based research and technology models. With three sites come the diverse perspectives necessary to succeed in solving tough multidisciplinary problems.BR&T–Europe has a staff of more than 50 employees, most of whom are engineers and scientists recruited from across Europe. It has become a key technology integrator, collaborating with more than 40 universities, 20 research centers, 5 airlines and more than 200 industry partners in 25 different countries.

entityDescription:
APPLUS+ Laboratories
Applus+ Laboratories (LGAI Technological Center S.A.) specialises in developing technical solutions to enhance product competitiveness and foster research and innovation thanks to our multidisciplinary and multisector competencies.
ENGINEERING
Applus+ Laboratories develops customized turnkey test bench and VHT (Virtual Hybrid Testing) projects, applying its engineering, mechanical, electrical, software, cybersecurity and automation skills together with its experience in testing and certification.
Thus, we are capable to reproduce components and systems behavior in different environments creating tailored testbed solutions whether to validate customer requirements and regulations or to study service failures and hardware/software resilience to cyber-attacks.
Applus+ Laboratories develops electrical, hydraulic and functional test equipment customized for integration into all the production stages of any vehicles components answering to manufacturers and integrators need to incorporate customized testing equipment into their production lines to validate their products at the component, subcomponent or full vehicle level, ensuring conformity with their requirements and the applicable regulations. 
MECHANICAL
Applus+ Laboratories material and structural testing laboratories cover a wide range that includes multi-axial tests – static and fatigue –on medium and heavy loads with quality granted by our ISO 17025 quality certification.
We also have the capabilities to reproduce the environmental and operating conditions over the useful life of a product in order to predict its performance, safety, reliability and durability. 
Our unique facilities allow us to validate the structural integrity of components and subcomponents of large dimensions, both of composite materials and metal, for the aerospace industry, defense, marine, railway, automotive, renewables, oil and gas, and civil construction.
Applus+ Laboratories is accredited as a strategic supplier of structural mechanical testing for the main aeronautical manufacturers. We are “preferred laboratory” for structural testing for Airbus (ST2S) and Rolls Royce, we have NADCAP accredited laboratories for testing metallic and non-metallic materials, and we have ISO 9100 certification for test tooling design.
CYBERSECURITY
Applus+ Laboratories is a global leader in testing, certification and consultancy services in payment systems and security for IT products such as chips, smart cards, telecommunications equipment, mobile devices, commercial software, SaaS and cloud computing systems. 
Applus+ Laboratories is an IT Security Evaluation Facility (ITSEF) accredited for Common Criteria and SOG-IS evaluations. We manage the process to obtain the Common Criteria Certification (ISO 15408:2005) for IT products.
Our capabilities includes Common Criteria Evaluations (up to level EAL 7), an international recognized standard to evaluate IT products security functionalities and assurances (ISO 15408) and depending on the evaluation level, Common Criteria requirements include:
•	Products evaluation: focused on risk vulnerabilities mitigation
•	Developer design evaluation: focused on ensuring development process reliability
•	Development Site Audits: focused on ensuring supply chain integrity and confidentiality.
ELECTRICS & ELECTRONICS (IoT)
Currently, in a vehicle the components and systems must be validated in compliance with industry standards in addition to the standards of each end manufacturer (OEMs).
The increasing integration of electronic systems in vehicles and their interaction with portable devices (IoT ecosystems) have made the development and validation of automotive products increasingly complex. In order to meet regulatory and industry standards for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and radio systems (RED), manufacturers need to evaluate and ensure the reliability of electrical and electronic components from the design and concept stage.

TECNOLOGIAS SERVICIOS TELEMATICOS Y SISTEMAS, S.A (TST) is an engineering company specialising in the design and implementation of customised IoT (Internet of Things) products and solutions for remote control applications in industry, precision agriculture, logistics and smart cities. TST is committed to create innovative solutions that improve process efficiency through digitalisation and data exploitation. TST's solutions are capable of providing intelligence to any infrastructure, urban or industrial, in a reliable way and guaranteeing data security.
TST was founded in 2007 by a group of entrepreneurs with academic and business backgrounds and many years of experience in technology start-ups.
With more than 15 years of expertise within the field of Industry 4.0, the company has a highly qualified engineering team with strong expertise on electronics design, sensors networks, wireless communications and IoT platforms. In 2024, TST merged with Wireless Innovative MMIC SL, a company with more than 7 years experience in the design of integrated circuits for different applications such as telecommunications and defence. Therefore, TST acquires all this expertise in the microelectronics industry.

easics is a System-on-Chip design & Semiconductor IP company, targeting designs in both FPGA and digital & mixed-signal ASIC technology.

easics licenses the following semiconductor three IP cores:

1. nearbAI (trademarked): embedded low-latency neural network inference that is used for pattern recognition close to the sensors, for integration in FPGA or ASIC
example application: earth observation in a satellite, so that it only needs to transmit results (about recognized objects) back to earth instead of full images. This saves a lot on the bandwidth of the wireless link form the satellite to earth.

2. TCP/IP offload engine: embedded low-latency high-throughput TCP/IP protocol stack, fully in hardware, for integration in FPGA or ASIC

3. S8: tiny embedded microcontroller, for integration in ASIC

easics designs reliable and scalable high-performance and low-power embedded systems for leading product companies active in imaging, wireless & wired communications, healthcare, industrial, aerospace / radiation-tolerant, multimedia and measurement equipment.

easics has an impeccable track record of building first-time-right systems-on-chip for several international companies, both OEMs (original equipment manufacturers) and semiconductor companies.

easics was founded in 1991 as a spin-off company from imec (Leuven, Belgium) and the Katholieke Universiteit Leuven - ESAT (Belgium).

We specialize in complete system development from the optical, mechanical and electronic design through to manufacture, assembly, integration and verification of state-of-the-art instrumentation. entityName: TECHNOLOGICAL CENTRE FOR TEXTILE AND CLOTHING OF PORTUGAL
entityDescription:
CITEVE is a Technological Center, a private non-profit organization, based in Vila Nova de Famalicão and with commercial branches in Brazil, Tunisia, Argentina, Pakistan, Chile and Mexico, that offers companies in the Textile and Clothing Sector, mainly SMEs (90%), a portfolio of services that includes laboratory tests, product certification, technical and technological consultancy, R&D+innovation, training, and fashion and design.
As a reference organization on the national and European scene, regarding the promotion of innovation and development of the Textile and Clothing Industry, CITEVE's mission is to support the development of technical and technological capabilities of the textile and clothing industries, by fostering and disseminating innovation, promoting quality improvement, and providing instrumental support to the definition of industrial policies for the sector.

Active since 1989, CITEVE is participated by companies (630), mostly SMEs based in the Northern region of Portugal. With a very close relationship with companies and a deep knowledge of the reality and performance of the sector, CITEVE also plays an important role in the definition and implementation of public policies.

Besides being a service provider to companies and a support organization with an active role in promoting knowledge and information to the sector, CITEVE is strategically positioned between academia (universities) and companies.
CITEVE's Missionis "to support the development of innovative capacity of companies, through the development and dissemination of scientific knowledge and technology, enhancement of creativity and instrumental support to the definition and implementation of public policies".
CITEVE and its collaborators guide their actions by the following values
- Innovation and Creativity
- Good standing, Knowledge and Quality
- Integrity, Independence, Transparency and Impartiality
- Cooperation and Loyalty
- Sustainability and Social and Environmental Responsibility

entityDescription: Institute of Botany of The Czech Academy of Sciences is a leading national institution in fundamental research on species, populations and communities of plants. The following diverse fields of study are represented: plant ecology (population biology, synecology, comparative and production ecology, ecophysiology) including geoinformatics and studies of spatio-temporal changes in populations and communities and their spatial structure on different scales, paleoecology, taxonomy, biosystematics and phytogeography of higher and lower plants, and mycorrhizal symbioses. Currently, the strongest research fields in terms of scientific outputs are ecology of invasive species, biodiversity and evolutionary trends among plants, responses of plants and vegetation to environmental change and the mechanisms that enable species to coexist in ecosystems.

entityDescription:
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS was founded in 1993 and is a leading Information Technologies (ICT) service provider and software developer in the field of e-government. We operate internationally as a group of companies, with offices and antennas in Luxembourg, Athens, Thessaloniki, Brussels, Berlin, Basel, Kaatsheuvel, Vienna, London, Milan, Nicosia, etc.
We design, develop, support and operate complex IT systems and commercialise our own software products and tools, using state-of-the-art technologies in the areas of:
- Bespoke development and delivery on IT projects on a turn-key basis, specialising in the field of e-government;
- IT consulting services - outsourcing;
- Outsourcing, SaaS (software as a service), cloud and managed services.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS expertise covers:
e-procurement, contract management, e-collaboration (workflow, content, document and knowledge management), customs and taxation applications, intellectual property, systems for the electronic publication of legislation, reporting systems in the finance sector, defence/law enforcement, etc.
Moreover, we participate in the implementation of a significant number of R&D projects worldwide.
The group uses a main development centre in Athens, Greece, supported by additional, fully owned development centres; near-shore and off-shore. This arrangement allows EUROPEAN DYNAMICS to compete optimally with all key players in the field of IT from Europe, America or Asia.
Our client portfolio comprises European Union Institutions and Agencies, International Organisations, national government administrations and the private sector.
The group generates annual revenues in excess of EURO 100 million, with an EBITDA margin in the range of 25% and is net profit and cash flow positive with a zero debt position (both short and long term).
The value of our contract portfolio exceeds EURO 300 million.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS employs over 1100 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 41% MSc and 54% BSc or equivalent). Our staff is multilingual and multinational with in-depth experience in the delivery of services to the government sector worldwide. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is an equal opportunity employer and applies an Equal Opportunities Policy (EOP). We also comply with all measures and obligations related to the prevention and combating of all forms of violence and harassment, including violence based on gender and sexual harassment.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for ICT systems integration, software design and development, ISO 27001:2022 certification for its hosting services platforms, ISO 20000-1:2018 for maintenance and support services for software applications and ISO 22301:2019 for development, implementation, maintenance and support of Information Technology Systems.
Security is a top priority area for the group. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS holds a NATO and EU secret security clearance. Moreover, the group applies state-of-the-art standards in ICT security (e.g. COBIT, UML, RUP, PRINCE2, Agile and ITIL).

We have established long term cooperation and business relations with a considerable number of hardware and software firms being a Systems Integrator, Value Added Reseller or Business Partner of a wide range of vendors, which include: CISCO, IBM, HP, ORACLE, MICROSOFT, REDHAT, SAS, ESRI, FILENET, OPENTEXT, UTIMACO, VMWARE, etc.

The University is currently running the following Departments: Home Economics and Ecology (Since 1993), Dietetics and Nutritional Science (Since 1994), Geography (Since 2000). The scientific subject matter of Geography in the new department is made up of knowledge about the subjects of Natural Geography, Human Geography and Applied Geography.
